scopeNotes: Real frontend delegation and execution modules plus authenticated deployed APIs and real Arbitrum Sepolia receipts were exercised; browser click-through was not exercised.
Both technical fixtures went pending first and were deployed via the normal preview admin approval API.
User funding happens on an eligible low-balance trade; no idle user batch funding or tournament reset was performed.
